items.question: How many PV string positions are available per MPPT on GW80K-ET-G10?
items.answer: The datasheet lists 8 MPPTs for the ET Series 75–100 kW models, which includes the GW80K-ET-G10. The number of strings per MPPT is not stated in the retrieved passages.
items.question_de: Wie viele PV-Stringanschlüsse stehen je MPP-Tracker beim GW80K-ET-G10 zur Verfügung?
items.answer_de: Das Datenblatt nennt 8 MPPTs für die ET-Serie 75–100 kW, zu der auch der GW80K-ET-G10 gehört. Die Anzahl der Strings je MPPT ist in den vorliegenden Passagen nicht angegeben.
items.reason: The retrieved passages state 8 MPPTs and a table of 9 to 16 PV strings across MPPT1 to MPPT8, but no passage states the number of string positions per MPPT for the GW80K-ET-G10.

items.question: Does GW80K-ET-G10 hold a German unit certificate for medium-voltage connection?
items.answer: The retrieved passages do not state a German unit certificate for medium-voltage connection for the GW80K-ET-G10. The datasheet only refers to the GoodWe website for the latest certificates.
